name: vision-inference-studio
description: Local visual workflow studio for real image and video inference
author: Vision Inference Studio

scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build:frontend && npm run build && npm run stage && electron-forge start
scripts.desktop:package: npm run build:frontend && npm run build && npm run stage && electron-forge package
scripts.desktop:make: npm run build:frontend && npm run build && npm run stage && electron-forge make
scripts.desktop:make:linux: npm run build:frontend && npm run build && npm run stage && electron-forge make --platform=linux --arch=x64
scripts.desktop:make:win32: npm run build:frontend && npm run build && npm run stage && electron-forge make --platform=win32 --arch=x64
